gloss: frequent; repeated; occurring in many instances

definitions.gloss: frequent; repeated; occurring in many instances
definitions.explanation: Describes events or phenomena that happen many times or in many locations. Often used in news and formal reporting to characterize incidents, accidents, or outbreaks that occur repeatedly.

examples.japanese: {多発的|たはつてき}な⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いた→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多発的|たはつてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きている→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
examples.english: Earthquakes are occurring frequently in this region.

examples.japanese: {多発的|たはつてき}な⟦{食中毒|しょくちゅうどく}→食中毒：07020_shokuchuudoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{報告|ほうこく}→報告：03618_houkoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けて→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧、{保健所|ほけんじょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: In response to frequent reports of food poisoning, the public health center launched an investigation.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{多発|たはつ}→多発：20508_tahatsu⟧ (frequent occurrence) and ⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧ (adjectival suffix). Used primarily in formal or news-style contexts to describe problems, incidents, or phenomena that happen repeatedly or in many places. The nuance tends to emphasize a pattern of repeated occurrences rather than a single spike.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {多発的|たはつてき}な⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧: frequent accidents
- {多発的|たはつてき}な⟦{犯罪|はんざい}→犯罪：03569_hanzai⟧: repeated crimes
- {多発的|たはつてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}する→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧: to occur frequently
- {多発的|たはつてき}な⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧: widespread damage

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{頻繁|ひんぱん}→頻繁：08631_hinpan⟧: frequent — more general and used in everyday conversation
- ⟦{多発|たはつ}→多発：20508_tahatsu⟧: frequent occurrence — the noun form, often used as a prefix (e.g., ⟦{多発|たはつ}→多発：20508_tahatsu⟧⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧)
- {散発的|さんぱつてき}: sporadic — occurring at irregular intervals, less concentrated than {多発的|たはつてき}
